extraction.Name: Samuel Allman
extraction.Refused/Protested: issued to you without your application or consent
extraction.NOTES: Document is a letter dated October 20, 1928, from the Superintendent at Pine Ridge Agency requesting Samuel Allman to come to the office to have his statement taken as an affidavit before a Notary Public, in response to a circular letter from the Indian Office requesting information from each Indian receiving a forced Patent. File reference: 5-1142. Letter initialed ELB:RER.
